_: Every model version main.parameters.json pins, with the inference-deprecation date
Azure has announced for it. model-deprecations.test.ts reads the parameter file,
refuses a pin this file does not list, and fails the build from thirty days before
a listed date — unless an acknowledgement below says somebody has read the live
deployment and has a plan, and for how long that holds.
Dates come from the Azure OpenAI model retirements page for the model and version,
read on the `checked` date. `unknown` means no retirement had been announced when
it was last read; it is not a promise. An acknowledgement may hold for at most
sixty days, so it cannot quietly become permanent.
